verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview names collective scheduling as a supported scheduling type. The slots API documents querying by usernames to find times when 2 or more people are available, which supports the shared-availability idea. However, the evidence never spells out collective team event types that show only slots where every required host is free. Missing for 10: explicit collective event-type documentation stating all hosts must be free, configuration of required hosts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can offer collective events that only show slots when every required host is free
